 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League B - Game Week 6 17 Nov 2026 - 11:45 Bilino Polje Stadium Bosnia and Herzegovina host Romania at Bilino Polje Stadium in Zenica in UEFA Nations League B Group 4, with both sides arriving in very different states of mind.
 Sergej Barbarez's side come into this match having just suffered a 3-2 defeat to Sweden on November 14, a result that ended their promotion hopes and confirmed Sweden's return to League A. Bosnia sit second in the group standings, but their campaign has stalled at a critical moment.
 Romania arrive with a rare lift. Gheorghe Hagi's side beat Poland 2-1 in their most recent Nations League outing, a result that snapped a run of four consecutive defeats in the competition. The Tricolorii had previously been thrashed 6-0 by Poland and lost 1-0 to Sweden, so this win carries genuine significance.
 The head-to-head record between these sides adds weight to the occasion. Bosnia won 4-2 in Zenica when the sides met earlier in this Nations League campaign, and they also beat Romania 3-1 in a World Cup qualifier in November 2025. Romania will want to correct that record on Bosnian soil.
 With Romania sitting bottom of Group 4 and needing points to avoid the drop, and Bosnia looking to recover from their Sweden defeat, this fixture has real stakes at both ends of the table.
